in_sanskrit.name: वौरवज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: वज्रपाणियुवराज (Vajrapāṇiyuvarāja) - the young king who holds the vajra (thunderbolt) in his hand, representing power and strength.

in_tamil.name: யுவராஜ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: யுவனாரசர் (yuvanārasar) - the king of the young.

in_telugu.name: యూవరాజ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: యూద్ధరాజ (yūddharāja) - the king who is a warrior.

in_marathi.name: Yuvaraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Prince, commander of the army
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yuvaraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Yuvaraj is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Yuva' meaning 'youth' and 'Raja' meaning 'king'. It is a name of respect and honor, symbolizing the power and potential that lies within a young man as he prepares to take on the responsibilities of leadership and rule.
